authorshipPolicy: You write your own response. A parent, tutor, or teacher may ask questions, model a skill on a different example, name a criterion, or restate the directions, but must not draft, dictate, outline, complete, reword, or supply sentences for your assessed work.
doNotUse: Do not write, dictate, outline, or complete the learner's response.
This rubric describes what to look for, not a single required answer — accept any response that meets the criteria.
